ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wql ja alhq wzhq albtl an albtl kan zhwqa
ayahs.translation_en: And say, "Truth has come, and falsehood has departed. Indeed is falsehood, [by nature], ever bound to depart."
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وقل جا الحق وزهق البطل ان البطل كان زهوقا

ayahs.text_ar: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءٌۭ وَرَحْمَةٌۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۙ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وننزل من القران ما هو شفا ورحمه للمومنين ولا يزيد الظلمين الا خسارا

ayahs.translation_en: And We send down of the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وننزل من القران ما هو شفا ورحمه للمومنين ولا يزيد الظلمين الا خسارا

ayahs.text_ar: وَإِذَآ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ ۖ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ كَانَ يَـُٔوسًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: واذا انعمنا علي الانسن اعرض ونا بجانبه واذا مسه الشر كان يوسا

ayahs.translation_en: And when We bestow favor upon the disbeliever, he turns away and distances himself; and when evil touches him, he is ever despairing.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: واذا انعمنا علي الانسن اعرض ونا بجانبه واذا مسه الشر كان يوسا

ayahs.text_ar: قُلْ كُلٌّۭ يَعْمَلُ عَلَىٰ شَاكِلَتِهِۦ فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ أَهْدَىٰ سَبِيلًۭا

ayahs.translation_en: Say, "Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way."

ayahs.text_ar: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلرُّوحِ ۖ قُلِ ٱلرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّى وَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: ويسلونك عن الروح قل الروح من امر ربي وما اوتيتم من العلم الا قليلا

ayahs.translation_en: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about the soul. Say, "The soul is of the affair of my Lord. And mankind have not been given of knowledge except a little."
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ويسلونك عن الروح قل الروح من امر ربي وما اوتيتم من العلم الا قليلا

ayahs.translation_en: And if We willed, We could surely do away with that which We revealed to you. Then you would not find for yourself concerning it an advocate against Us.

ayahs.transliteration_normalized: ala rhmh mn rbk an fdlh kan alyk kbyra
ayahs.translation_en: Except [We have left it with you] as a mercy from your Lord. Indeed, His favor upon you has ever been great.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: الا رحمه من ربك ان فضله كان عليك كبيرا

ayahs.text_ar: قُل لَّئِنِ ٱجْتَمَعَتِ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَأْتُوا۟ بِمِثْلِ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ لَا يَأْتُونَ بِمِثْلِهِۦ وَلَوْ كَانَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍۢ ظَهِيرًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: قل لين اجتمعت الانس والجن علي ان ياتوا بمثل هذا القران لا ياتون بمثله ولو كان بعضهم لبعض ظهيرا

ayahs.text_ar: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍۢ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: ولقد صرفنا للناس في هذا القران من كل مثل فابي اكثر الناس الا كفورا

ayahs.translation_en: And We have certainly diversified for the people in this Qur'an from every [kind] of example, but most of the people refused [anything] except disbelief.

ayahs.text_ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ تَفْجُرَ لَنَا مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ يَنۢبُوعًا

ayahs.translation_en: And they say, "We will not believe you until you break open for us from the ground a spring.

ayahs.text_ar: أَوْ تَكُونَ لَكَ جَنَّةٌۭ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَعِنَبٍۢ فَتُفَجِّرَ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرَ خِلَٰلَهَا تَفْجِيرًا

ayahs.translation_en: Or [until] you have a garden of palm tress and grapes and make rivers gush forth within them in force [and abundance]
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: او تكون لك جنه من نخيل وعنب فتفجر الانهر خللها تفجيرا

ayahs.text_ar: أَوْ تُسْقِطَ ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَمَا زَعَمْتَ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا أَوْ تَأْتِىَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ قَبِيلًا

ayahs.translation_en: Or you make the heaven fall upon us in fragments as you have claimed or you bring Allah and the angels before [us]
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: او تسقط السما كما زعمت علينا كسفا او تاتي بالله والمليكه قبيلا

ayahs.text_ar: أَوْ يَكُونَ لَكَ بَيْتٌۭ مِّن زُخْرُفٍ أَوْ تَرْقَىٰ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَلَن نُّؤْمِنَ لِرُقِيِّكَ حَتَّىٰ تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا كِتَٰبًۭا نَّقْرَؤُهُۥ ۗ قُلْ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّى هَلْ كُنتُ إِلَّا بَشَرًۭا رَّسُولًۭا

ayahs.translation_en: Or you have a house of gold or you ascend into the sky. And [even then], we will not believe in your ascension until you bring down to us a book we may read." Say, "Exalted is my Lord! Was I ever but a human messenger?"

ayahs.text_ar: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَلَٰٓئِكَةٌۭ يَمْشُونَ مُطْمَئِنِّينَ لَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَلَكًۭا رَّسُولًۭا

ayahs.text_ar: قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًۭا

ayahs.translation_en: Say, "Sufficient is Allah as Witness between me and you. Indeed he is ever, concerning His servants, Acquainted and Seeing."

ayahs.text_ar: وَمَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَهُوَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِ ۖ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۖ وَنَحْشُرُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ عُمْيًۭا وَبُكْمًۭا وَصُمًّۭا ۖ مَّأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ كُلَّمَا خَبَتْ زِدْنَٰهُمْ سَعِيرًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: ومن يهد الله فهو المهتد ومن يضلل فلن تجد لهم اوليا من دونه ونحشرهم يوم القيمه علي وجوههم عميا وبكما وصما ماويهم جهنم كلما خبت زدنهم سعيرا

ayahs.translation_en: And whoever Allah guides - he is the [rightly] guided; and whoever He sends astray - you will never find for them protectors besides Him, and We will gather them on the Day of Resurrection [fallen] on their faces - blind, dumb and deaf. Their refuge is Hell; every time it subsides We increase them in blazing fire.

ayahs.text_ar: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُم بِأَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًۭا وَرُفَٰتًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًۭا جَدِيدًا

ayahs.text_ar: ۞ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَهُمْ أَجَلًۭا لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ فَأَبَى ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ إِلَّا كُفُورًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: اولم يروا ان الله الذي خلق السموت والارض قادر علي ان يخلق مثلهم وجعل لهم اجلا لا ريب فيه فابي الظلمون الا كفورا

ayahs.translation_en: Do they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and earth, is [the one] Able to create the likes of them? And He has appointed for them a term, about which there is no doubt. But the wrongdoers refuse [anything] except disbelief.

ayahs.text_ar: قُل لَّوْ أَنتُمْ تَمْلِكُونَ خَزَآئِنَ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّىٓ إِذًۭا لَّأَمْسَكْتُمْ خَشْيَةَ ٱلْإِنفَاقِ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ قَتُورًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: قل لو انتم تملكون خزاين رحمه ربي اذا لامسكتم خشيه الانفاق وكان الانسن قتورا
ayahs.transliteration: ql lw antm tmlkwn khzaan rhmh rby adha lamsktm khshyh alanfaq wkan alansn qtwra
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: ql lw antm tmlkwn hzan rhmh rby ada lamsktm hsyh alanfaq wkan alansn qtwra
ayahs.translation_en: Say [to them], "If you possessed the depositories of the mercy of my Lord, then you would withhold out of fear of spending." And ever has man been stingy.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: قل لو انتم تملكون خزاين رحمه ربي اذا لامسكتم خشيه الانفاق وكان الانسن قتورا

ayahs.text_ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ ۖ فَسْـَٔلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: ولقد اتينا موسي تسع ايت بينت فسل بني اسريل اذ جاهم فقال له فرعون اني لاظنك يموسي مسحورا
ayahs.transliteration: wlqd atyna mwsy tsa ayt bynt fsl bny asryl adh jahm fqal lh frawn any laznk ymwsy mshwra
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wlqd atyna mwsy tsa ayt bynt fsl bny asryl ad jahm fqal lh frawn any laznk ymwsy mswra
ayahs.translation_en: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic."
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ولقد اتينا موسي تسع ايت بينت فسل بني اسريل اذ جاهم فقال له فرعون اني لاظنك يموسي مسحورا

ayahs.text_ar: قَالَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَآ أَنزَلَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ بَصَآئِرَ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَٰفِرْعَوْنُ مَثْبُورًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: قال لقد علمت ما انزل هولا الا رب السموت والارض بصاير واني لاظنك يفرعون مثبورا
ayahs.transliteration: qal lqd almt ma anzl hula ala rb alsmwt walard bsaar wany laznk yfrawn mthbwra
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: qal lqd almt ma anzl hula ala rb alsmwt walard bsar wany laznk yfrawn mtbwra
ayahs.translation_en: [Moses] said, "You have already known that none has sent down these [signs] except the Lord of the heavens and the earth as evidence, and indeed I think, O Pharaoh, that you are destroyed."
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: قال لقد علمت ما انزل هولا الا رب السموت والارض بصاير واني لاظنك يفرعون مثبورا

ayahs.text_ar: فَأَرَادَ أَن يَسْتَفِزَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ جَمِيعًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: فاراد ان يستفزهم من الارض فاغرقنه ومن معه جميعا
ayahs.transliteration: farad an ystfzhm mn alard faghrqnh wmn mah jmyaa
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: farad an ystfzhm mn alard fagrqnh wmn mah jmya
ayahs.translation_en: So he intended to drive them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him all together.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: فاراد ان يستفزهم من الارض فاغرقنه ومن معه جميعا

ayahs.text_ar: وَقُلْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ لِبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱسْكُنُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ جِئْنَا بِكُمْ لَفِيفًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وقلنا من بعده لبني اسريل اسكنوا الارض فاذا جا وعد الاخره جينا بكم لفيفا
ayahs.transliteration: wqlna mn badh lbny asryl asknwa alard fadha ja wad alakhrh jana bkm lfyfa
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wqlna mn bad lbny asryl asknwa alard fada ja wad alahrh jana bkm lfyfa
ayahs.translation_en: And We said after Pharaoh to the Children of Israel, "Dwell in the land, and when there comes the promise of the Hereafter, We will bring you forth in [one] gathering."
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وقلنا من بعده لبني اسريل اسكنوا الارض فاذا جا وعد الاخره جينا بكم لفيفا

ayahs.text_ar: وَبِٱلْحَقِّ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ وَبِٱلْحَقِّ نَزَلَ ۗ وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًۭا وَنَذِيرًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وبالحق انزلنه وبالحق نزل وما ارسلنك الا مبشرا ونذيرا

ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wbalhq anzlnh wbalhq nzl wma arslnk ala mbsra wndyra
ayahs.translation_en: And with the truth We have sent the Qur'an down, and with the truth it has descended. And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وبالحق انزلنه وبالحق نزل وما ارسلنك الا مبشرا ونذيرا

ayahs.text_ar: وَقُرْءَانًۭا فَرَقْنَٰهُ لِتَقْرَأَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ مُكْثٍۢ وَنَزَّلْنَٰهُ تَنزِيلًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وقرانا فرقنه لتقراه علي الناس علي مكث ونزلنه تنزيلا
ayahs.transliteration: wqrana frqnh ltqrah aly alnas aly mkth wnzlnh tnzyla
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wqrana frqnh ltqrah aly alnas aly mkt wnzlnh tnzyla
ayahs.translation_en: And [it is] a Qur'an which We have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. And We have sent it down progressively.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وقرانا فرقنه لتقراه علي الناس علي مكث ونزلنه تنزيلا

ayahs.text_ar: قُلْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَوْ لَا تُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦٓ إِذَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ يَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ سُجَّدًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: قل امنوا به او لا تومنوا ان الذين اوتوا العلم من قبله اذا يتلي عليهم يخرون للاذقان سجدا

ayahs.translation_en: Say, "Believe in it or do not believe. Indeed, those who were given knowledge before it - when it is recited to them, they fall upon their faces in prostration,
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: قل امنوا به او لا تومنوا ان الذين اوتوا العلم من قبله اذا يتلي عليهم يخرون للاذقان سجدا

ayahs.text_ar: وَيَقُولُونَ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِن كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُولًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: ويقولون سبحن ربنا ان كان وعد ربنا لمفعولا

ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wyqwlwn sbhn rbna an kan wad rbna lmfawla
ayahs.translation_en: And they say, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled."

ayahs.text_ar: وَيَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ يَبْكُونَ وَيَزِيدُهُمْ خُشُوعًۭا ۩
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: ويخرون للاذقان يبكون ويزيدهم خشوعا

ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wyhrwn lladqan ybkwn wyzydm hswa
ayahs.translation_en: And they fall upon their faces weeping, and the Qur'an increases them in humble submission.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ويخرون للاذقان يبكون ويزيدهم خشوعا

ayahs.text_ar: قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ أَوِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ ۖ أَيًّۭا مَّا تَدْعُوا۟ فَلَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَٱبْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: قل ادعوا الله او ادعوا الرحمن ايا ما تدعوا فله الاسما الحسني ولا تجهر بصلاتك ولا تخافت بها وابتغ بين ذلك سبيلا
ayahs.transliteration: ql adawa allh aw adawa alrhmn aya ma tdawa flh alasma alhsny wla tjhr bslatk wla tkhaft bha wabtgh byn dhlk sbyla
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: ql adawa allh aw adawa alrhmn aya ma tdawa flh alasma alhsny wla tjhr bslatk wla taft bha wabtg byn dlk sbyla
ayahs.translation_en: Say, "Call upon Allah or call upon the Most Merciful. Whichever [name] you call - to Him belong the best names." And do not recite [too] loudly in your prayer or [too] quietly but seek between that an [intermediate] way.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: قل ادعوا الله او ادعوا الرحمن ايا ما تدعوا فله الاسما الحسني ولا تجهر بصلاتك ولا تخافت بها وابتغ بين ذلك سبيلا

ayahs.text_ar: وَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًۭا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٌۭ فِى ٱلْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ وَلِىٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلذُّلِّ ۖ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيرًۢا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وقل الحمد لله الذي لم يتخذ ولدا ولم يكن له شريك في الملك ولم يكن له ولي من الذل وكبره تكبيرا

ayahs.translation_en: And say, "Praise to Allah, who has not taken a son and has had no partner in [His] dominion and has no [need of a] protector out of weakness; and glorify Him with [great] glorification."
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وقل الحمد لله الذي لم يتخذ ولدا ولم يكن له شريك في الملك ولم يكن له ولي من الذل وكبره تكبيرا

ayahs.text_ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَلَمْ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عِوَجَا ۜ
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله الذي انزل علي عبده الكتب ولم يجعل له عوجا

ayahs.translation_en: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, who has sent down upon His Servant the Book and has not made therein any deviance.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: الحمد لله الذي انزل علي عبده الكتب ولم يجعل له عوجا

ayahs.text_ar: قَيِّمًۭا لِّيُنذِرَ بَأْسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا مِّن لَّدُنْهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا حَسَنًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: قيما لينذر باسا شديدا من لدنه ويبشر المومنين الذين يعملون الصلحت ان لهم اجرا حسنا

ayahs.translation_en: [He has made it] straight, to warn of severe punishment from Him and to give good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a good reward

ayahs.transliteration_normalized: mktyn fyh abda

ayahs.text_ar: وَيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدًۭا

ayahs.text_ar: مَّا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍۢ وَلَا لِءَابَآئِهِمْ ۚ كَبُرَتْ كَلِمَةًۭ تَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ ۚ إِن يَقُولُونَ إِلَّا كَذِبًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: ما لهم به من علم ولا لابايهم كبرت كلمه تخرج من افوههم ان يقولون الا كذبا

ayahs.translation_en: They have no knowledge of it, nor had their fathers. Grave is the word that comes out of their mouths; they speak not except a lie.

ayahs.text_ar: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمْ إِن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَسَفًا

ayahs.translation_en: Then perhaps you would kill yourself through grief over them, [O Muhammad], if they do not believe in this message, [and] out of sorrow.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: فلعلك بخع نفسك علي اثرهم ان لم يومنوا بهذا الحديث اسفا

ayahs.text_ar: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ زِينَةًۭ لَّهَا لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا

ayahs.text_ar: وَإِنَّا لَجَٰعِلُونَ مَا عَلَيْهَا صَعِيدًۭا جُرُزًا

ayahs.text_ar: أَمْ حَسِبْتَ أَنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْكَهْفِ وَٱلرَّقِيمِ كَانُوا۟ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا عَجَبًا

ayahs.translation_en: Or have you thought that the companions of the cave and the inscription were, among Our signs, a wonder?
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ام حسبت ان اصحب الكهف والرقيم كانوا من ايتنا عجبا

ayahs.text_ar: إِذْ أَوَى ٱلْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى ٱلْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةًۭ وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: اذ اوي الفتيه الي الكهف فقالوا ربنا اتنا من لدنك رحمه وهيي لنا من امرنا رشدا
ayahs.transliteration: adh awy alftyh aly alkhf fqalwa rbna atna mn ldnk rhmh whya lna mn amrna rshda
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: awy alftyh aly alhf fqalwa rbna atna mn ldnk rhmh whya lna mn amrna rsda
ayahs.translation_en: [Mention] when the youths retreated to the cave and said, "Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance."
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: اذ اوي الفتيه الي الكهف فقالوا ربنا اتنا من لدنك رحمه وهيي لنا من امرنا رشدا

ayahs.text_ar: فَضَرَبْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ فِى ٱلْكَهْفِ سِنِينَ عَدَدًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: فضربنا علي اذانهم في الكهف سنين عددا
ayahs.transliteration: fdrbna aly adhanhm fy alkhf snyn adda
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: fdrbna aly adanhm fy alhf snyn adda
ayahs.translation_en: So We cast [a cover of sleep] over their ears within the cave for a number of years.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: فضربنا علي اذانهم في الكهف سنين عددا

ayahs.text_ar: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَٰهُمْ لِنَعْلَمَ أَىُّ ٱلْحِزْبَيْنِ أَحْصَىٰ لِمَا لَبِثُوٓا۟ أَمَدًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: ثم بعثنهم لنعلم اي الحزبين احصي لما لبثوا امدا
ayahs.transliteration: thm bathnhm lnalm ay alhzbyn ahsy lma lbthwa amda
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: tm batnhm lnalm ay alhzbyn ahsy lma lbtwa amda
ayahs.translation_en: Then We awakened them that We might show which of the two factions was most precise in calculating what [extent] they had remained in time.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ثم بعثنهم لنعلم اي الحزبين احصي لما لبثوا امدا

ayahs.text_ar: نَّحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ نَبَأَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ فِتْيَةٌ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ وَزِدْنَٰهُمْ هُدًۭى
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: نحن نقص عليك نباهم بالحق انهم فتيه امنوا بربهم وزدنهم هدي
ayahs.transliteration: nhn nqs alyk nbahm balhq anhm ftyh amnwa brbhm wzdnhm hdy
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: nhn nqs alyk nbahm balhq anhm ftyh amnwa brbhm wzdnhm hdy
ayahs.translation_en: It is We who relate to you, [O Muhammad], their story in truth. Indeed, they were youths who believed in their Lord, and We increased them in guidance.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: نحن نقص عليك نباهم بالحق انهم فتيه امنوا بربهم وزدنهم هدي

ayahs.text_ar: وَرَبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ إِذْ قَامُوا۟ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَن نَّدْعُوَا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَٰهًۭا ۖ لَّقَدْ قُلْنَآ إِذًۭا شَطَطًا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وربطنا علي قلوبهم اذ قاموا فقالوا ربنا رب السموت والارض لن ندعوا من دونه الها لقد قلنا اذا شططا
ayahs.transliteration: wrbtna aly qlwbhm adh qamwa fqalwa rbna rb alsmwt walard ln ndawa mn dwnh alha lqd qlna adha shtta
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wrbtna aly qlwbhm ad qamwa fqalwa rbna rb alsmwt walard ln ndawa mn dwnh alha lqd qlna ada stta
ayahs.translation_en: And We made firm their hearts when they stood up and said, "Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. Never will we invoke besides Him any deity. We would have certainly spoken, then, an excessive transgression.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وربطنا علي قلوبهم اذ قاموا فقالوا ربنا رب السموت والارض لن ندعوا من دونه الها لقد قلنا اذا شططا

ayahs.text_ar: هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمُنَا ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةًۭ ۖ لَّوْلَا يَأْتُونَ عَلَيْهِم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۭ بَيِّنٍۢ ۖ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: هولا قومنا اتخذوا من دونه الهه لولا ياتون عليهم بسلطن بين فمن اظلم ممن افتري علي الله كذبا
ayahs.transliteration: hula qwmna atkhdhwa mn dwnh alhh lwla yatwn alyhm bsltn byn fmn azlm mmn aftry aly allh kdhba
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: hula qwmna atdwa mn dwnh alhh lwla yatwn alyhm bsltn byn fmn azlm mmn aftry aly allh kdba
ayahs.translation_en: These, our people, have taken besides Him deities. Why do they not bring for [worship of] them a clear authority? And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah a lie?"
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: هولا قومنا اتخذوا من دونه الهه لولا ياتون عليهم بسلطن بين فمن اظلم ممن افتري علي الله كذبا

ayahs.text_ar: وَإِذِ ٱعْتَزَلْتُمُوهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ فَأْوُۥٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلْكَهْفِ يَنشُرْ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَيُهَيِّئْ لَكُم مِّنْ أَمْرِكُم مِّرْفَقًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: واذ اعتزلتموهم وما يعبدون الا الله فاوا الي الكهف ينشر لكم ربكم من رحمته ويهيي لكم من امركم مرفقا
ayahs.transliteration: wadh aatzltmwhm wma yabdwn ala allh fawa aly alkhf ynshr lkm rbkm mn rhmth wyhya lkm mn amrkm mrfqa
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wad atzltmwhm wma yabdwn ala allh fawa aly alhf ynsr lkm rbkm mn rhmt wyhya lkm mn amrkm mrfqa
ayahs.translation_en: [The youths said to one another], "And when you have withdrawn from them and that which they worship other than Allah, retreat to the cave. Your Lord will spread out for you of His mercy and will prepare for you from your affair facility."
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: واذ اعتزلتموهم وما يعبدون الا الله فاوا الي الكهف ينشر لكم ربكم من رحمته ويهيي لكم من امركم مرفقا

ayahs.text_ar: ۞ وَتَرَى ٱلشَّمْسَ إِذَا طَلَعَت تَّزَٰوَرُ عَن كَهْفِهِمْ ذَاتَ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَإِذَا غَرَبَت تَّقْرِضُهُمْ ذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ وَهُمْ فِى فَجْوَةٍۢ مِّنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ مَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَهُوَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِ ۖ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُۥ وَلِيًّۭا مُّرْشِدًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وتري الشمس اذا طلعت تزور عن كهفهم ذات اليمين واذا غربت تقرضهم ذات الشمال وهم في فجوه منه ذلك من ايت الله من يهد الله فهو المهتد ومن يضلل فلن تجد له وليا مرشدا
ayahs.transliteration: wtry alshms adha tlat tzwr an khfhm dhat alymyn wadha ghrbt tqrdhm dhat alshmal whm fy fjwh mnh dhlk mn ayt allh mn yhd allh fhw almhtd wmn ydll fln tjd lh wlya mrshda
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wtry alsms ada tlat tzwr an hfhm dat alymyn wada grbt tqrdm dat alsmal whm fy fjwh mnh dlk mn ayt allh mn yhd allh fhw almhtd wmn ydll fln tjd lh wlya mrsda
ayahs.translation_en: And [had you been present], you would see the sun when it rose, inclining away from their cave on the right, and when it set, passing away from them on the left, while they were [laying] within an open space thereof. That was from the signs of Allah. He whom Allah guides is the [rightly] guided, but he whom He leaves astray - never will you find for him a protecting guide.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وتري الشمس اذا طلعت تزور عن كهفهم ذات اليمين واذا غربت تقرضهم ذات الشمال وهم في فجوه منه ذلك من ايت الله من يهد الله فهو المهتد ومن يضلل فلن تجد له وليا مرشدا

ayahs.text_ar: وَتَحْسَبُهُمْ أَيْقَاظًۭا وَهُمْ رُقُودٌۭ ۚ وَنُقَلِّبُهُمْ ذَاتَ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ ۖ وَكَلْبُهُم بَٰسِطٌۭ ذِرَاعَيْهِ بِٱلْوَصِيدِ ۚ لَوِ ٱطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَوَلَّيْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِرَارًۭا وَلَمُلِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ رُعْبًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وتحسبهم ايقاظا وهم رقود ونقلبهم ذات اليمين وذات الشمال وكلبهم بسط ذراعيه بالوصيد لو اطلعت عليهم لوليت منهم فرارا ولمليت منهم رعبا
ayahs.transliteration: wthsbhm ayqaza whm rqwd wnqlbhm dhat alymyn wdhat alshmal wklbhm bst dhraayh balwsyd lw atlat alyhm lwlyt mnhm frara wlmlat mnhm raba
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wtsbhm ayqaza whm rqwd wnqlbhm dat alymyn wdat alsmal wklbhm bst drayh balwsyd lw atlat alyhm lwlyt mnhm frara wlmlat mnhm raba
ayahs.translation_en: And you would think them awake, while they were asleep. And We turned them to the right and to the left, while their dog stretched his forelegs at the entrance. If you had looked at them, you would have turned from them in flight and been filled by them with terror.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وتحسبهم ايقاظا وهم رقود ونقلبهم ذات اليمين وذات الشمال وكلبهم بسط ذراعيه بالوصيد لو اطلعت عليهم لوليت منهم فرارا ولمليت منهم رعبا

ayahs.text_ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ بَعَثْنَٰهُمْ لِيَتَسَآءَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ قَالَ قَآئِلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍۢ ۚ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثْتُمْ فَٱبْعَثُوٓا۟ أَحَدَكُم بِوَرِقِكُمْ هَٰذِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ فَلْيَنظُرْ أَيُّهَآ أَزْكَىٰ طَعَامًۭا فَلْيَأْتِكُم بِرِزْقٍۢ مِّنْهُ وَلْيَتَلَطَّفْ وَلَا يُشْعِرَنَّ بِكُمْ أَحَدًا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وكذلك بعثنهم ليتسالوا بينهم قال قايل منهم كم لبثتم قالوا لبثنا يوما او بعض يوم قالوا ربكم اعلم بما لبثتم فابعثوا احدكم بورقكم هذه الي المدينه فلينظر ايها ازكي طعاما فلياتكم برزق منه وليتلطف ولا يشعرن بكم احدا
ayahs.transliteration: wkdhlk bathnhm lytsalwa bynhm qal qaal mnhm km lbthtm qalwa lbthna ywma aw bad ywm qalwa rbkm aalm bma lbthtm fabathwa ahdkm bwrqkm hdhh aly almdynh flynzr ayha azky taama flyatkm brzq mnh wlytltf wla ysharn bkm ahda
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wkdlk batnhm lytsalwa bynhm qal qal mnhm km lbttm qalwa lbtna ywma aw bad ywm qalwa rbkm alm bma lbttm fabatwa ahdkm bwrqkm hdh aly almdynh flynzr ayha azky tama flyatkm brzq mnh wlytltf wla ysarn bkm ahda
ayahs.translation_en: And similarly, We awakened them that they might question one another. Said a speaker from among them, "How long have you remained [here]?" They said, "We have remained a day or part of a day." They said, "Your Lord is most knowing of how long you remained. So send one of you with this silver coin of yours to the city and let him look to which is the best of food and bring you provision from it and let him be cautious. And let no one be aware of you.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وكذلك بعثنهم ليتسالوا بينهم قال قايل منهم كم لبثتم قالوا لبثنا يوما او بعض يوم قالوا ربكم اعلم بما لبثتم فابعثوا احدكم بورقكم هذه الي المدينه فلينظر ايها ازكي طعاما فلياتكم برزق منه وليتلطف ولا يشعرن بكم احدا

ayahs.text_ar: إِنَّهُمْ إِن يَظْهَرُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ يَرْجُمُوكُمْ أَوْ يُعِيدُوكُمْ فِى مِلَّتِهِمْ وَلَن تُفْلِحُوٓا۟ إِذًا أَبَدًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: انهم ان يظهروا عليكم يرجموكم او يعيدوكم في ملتهم ولن تفلحوا اذا ابدا
ayahs.transliteration: anhm an yzhrwa alykm yrjmwkm aw yaydwkm fy mlthm wln tflhwa adha abda
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: anhm an yzhrwa alykm yrjmwkm aw yaydwkm fy mltm wln tflhwa ada abda
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, if they come to know of you, they will stone you or return you to their religion. And never would you succeed, then - ever."
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: انهم ان يظهروا عليكم يرجموكم او يعيدوكم في ملتهم ولن تفلحوا اذا ابدا

ayahs.text_ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَعْثَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ لِيَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ وَأَنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَآ إِذْ يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَمْرَهُمْ ۖ فَقَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ عَلَيْهِم بُنْيَٰنًۭا ۖ رَّبُّهُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِهِمْ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ غَلَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِمْ لَنَتَّخِذَنَّ عَلَيْهِم مَّسْجِدًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وكذلك اعثرنا عليهم ليعلموا ان وعد الله حق وان الساعه لا ريب فيها اذ يتنزعون بينهم امرهم فقالوا ابنوا عليهم بنينا ربهم اعلم بهم قال الذين غلبوا علي امرهم لنتخذن عليهم مسجدا
ayahs.transliteration: wkdhlk aathrna alyhm lyalmwa an wad allh hq wan alsaah la ryb fyha adh ytnzawn bynhm amrhm fqalwa abnwa alyhm bnyna rbhm aalm bhm qal aldhyn ghlbwa aly amrhm lntkhdhn alyhm msjda
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wkdlk atrna alyhm lyalmwa an wad allh hq wan alsah la ryb fyha ad ytnzawn bynhm amrhm fqalwa abnwa alyhm bnyna rbhm alm bhm qal aldyn glbwa aly amrhm lntdn alyhm msjda
ayahs.translation_en: And similarly, We caused them to be found that they [who found them] would know that the promise of Allah is truth and that of the Hour there is no doubt. [That was] when they disputed among themselves about their affair and [then] said, "Construct over them a structure. Their Lord is most knowing about them." Said those who prevailed in the matter, "We will surely take [for ourselves] over them a masjid."
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وكذلك اعثرنا عليهم ليعلموا ان وعد الله حق وان الساعه لا ريب فيها اذ يتنزعون بينهم امرهم فقالوا ابنوا عليهم بنينا ربهم اعلم بهم قال الذين غلبوا علي امرهم لنتخذن عليهم مسجدا

ayahs.text_ar: سَيَقُولُونَ ثَلَٰثَةٌۭ رَّابِعُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ خَمْسَةٌۭ سَادِسُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ رَجْمًۢا بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ وَيَقُولُونَ سَبْعَةٌۭ وَثَامِنُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ ۚ قُل رَّبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِعِدَّتِهِم مَّا يَعْلَمُهُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌۭ ۗ فَلَا تُمَارِ فِيهِمْ إِلَّا مِرَآءًۭ ظَٰهِرًۭا وَلَا تَسْتَفْتِ فِيهِم مِّنْهُمْ أَحَدًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: سيقولون ثلثه رابعهم كلبهم ويقولون خمسه سادسهم كلبهم رجما بالغيب ويقولون سبعه وثامنهم كلبهم قل ربي اعلم بعدتهم ما يعلمهم الا قليل فلا تمار فيهم الا مرا ظهرا ولا تستفت فيهم منهم احدا
ayahs.transliteration: syqwlwn thlthh rabahm klbhm wyqwlwn khmsh sadshm klbhm rjma balghyb wyqwlwn sbah wthamnhm klbhm ql rby aalm badthm ma yalmhm ala qlyl fla tmar fyhm ala mra zhra wla tstft fyhm mnhm ahda
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: syqwlwn tlth rabahm klbhm wyqwlwn hms sadsm klbhm rjma balgyb wyqwlwn sbah wtamnhm klbhm ql rby alm badtm ma yalmhm ala qlyl fla tmar fyhm ala mra zhra wla tstft fyhm mnhm ahda
ayahs.translation_en: They will say there were three, the fourth of them being their dog; and they will say there were five, the sixth of them being their dog - guessing at the unseen; and they will say there were seven, and the eighth of them was their dog. Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord is most knowing of their number. None knows them except a few. So do not argue about them except with an obvious argument and do not inquire about them among [the speculators] from anyone."

ayahs.translation_en: And why did you, when you entered your garden, not say, 'What Allah willed [has occurred]; there is no power except in Allah '? Although you see me less than you in wealth and children,
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ولولا اذ دخلت جنتك قلت ما شا الله لا قوه الا بالله ان ترن انا اقل منك مالا وولدا

ayahs.text_ar: فَعَسَىٰ رَبِّىٓ أَن يُؤْتِيَنِ خَيْرًۭا مِّن جَنَّتِكَ وَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهَا حُسْبَانًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتُصْبِحَ صَعِيدًۭا زَلَقًا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: فعسي ربي ان يوتين خيرا من جنتك ويرسل عليها حسبانا من السما فتصبح صعيدا زلقا
ayahs.transliteration: fasy rby an yutyn khyra mn jntk wyrsl alyha hsbana mn alsma ftsbh sayda zlqa
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: fasy rby an yutyn hyra mn jntk wyrsl alyha hsbana mn alsma ftsbh sayda zlqa
ayahs.translation_en: It may be that my Lord will give me [something] better than your garden and will send upon it a calamity from the sky, and it will become a smooth, dusty ground,
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: فعسي ربي ان يوتين خيرا من جنتك ويرسل عليها حسبانا من السما فتصبح صعيدا زلقا

ayahs.text_ar: أَوْ يُصْبِحَ مَآؤُهَا غَوْرًۭا فَلَن تَسْتَطِيعَ لَهُۥ طَلَبًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: او يصبح ماوها غورا فلن تستطيع له طلبا
ayahs.transliteration: aw ysbh mauha ghwra fln tsttya lh tlba
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: aw ysbh mauha gwra fln tsttya lh tlba
ayahs.translation_en: Or its water will become sunken [into the earth], so you would never be able to seek it."
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: او يصبح ماوها غورا فلن تستطيع له طلبا

ayahs.text_ar: وَأُحِيطَ بِثَمَرِهِۦ فَأَصْبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَنفَقَ فِيهَا وَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُشْرِكْ بِرَبِّىٓ أَحَدًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: واحيط بثمره فاصبح يقلب كفيه علي ما انفق فيها وهي خاويه علي عروشها ويقول يليتني لم اشرك بربي احدا
ayahs.transliteration: wahyt bthmrh fasbh yqlb kfyh aly ma anfq fyha why khawyh aly arwshha wyqwl ylytny lm ashrk brby ahda
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wahyt btmrh fasbh yqlb kfyh aly ma anfq fyha why hawyh aly arwsha wyqwl ylytny lm asrk brby ahda
ayahs.translation_en: And his fruits were encompassed [by ruin], so he began to turn his hands about [in dismay] over what he had spent on it, while it had collapsed upon its trellises, and said, "Oh, I wish I had not associated with my Lord anyone."
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: واحيط بثمره فاصبح يقلب كفيه علي ما انفق فيها وهي خاويه علي عروشها ويقول يليتني لم اشرك بربي احدا

ayahs.text_ar: وَلَمْ تَكُن لَّهُۥ فِئَةٌۭ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مُنتَصِرًا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: ولم تكن له فيه ينصرونه من دون الله وما كان منتصرا
ayahs.transliteration: wlm tkn lh fah ynsrwnh mn dwn allh wma kan mntsra
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wlm tkn lh fah ynsrwnh mn dwn allh wma kan mntsra
ayahs.translation_en: And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allah, nor could he defend himself.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ولم تكن له فيه ينصرونه من دون الله وما كان منتصرا

ayahs.text_ar: هُنَالِكَ ٱلْوَلَٰيَةُ لِلَّهِ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ هُوَ خَيْرٌۭ ثَوَابًۭا وَخَيْرٌ عُقْبًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: هنالك الوليه لله الحق هو خير ثوابا وخير عقبا
ayahs.transliteration: hnalk alwlyh llh alhq hw khyr thwaba wkhyr aqba
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: hnalk alwlyh llh alhq hw hyr twaba whyr aqba
ayahs.translation_en: There the authority is [completely] for Allah, the Truth. He is best in reward and best in outcome.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: هنالك الوليه لله الحق هو خير ثوابا وخير عقبا

ayahs.text_ar: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا كَمَآءٍ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَٱخْتَلَطَ بِهِۦ نَبَاتُ ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَصْبَحَ هَشِيمًۭا تَذْرُوهُ ٱلرِّيَٰحُ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرًا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: واضرب لهم مثل الحيوه الدنيا كما انزلنه من السما فاختلط به نبات الارض فاصبح هشيما تذروه الريح وكان الله علي كل شي مقتدرا
ayahs.transliteration: wadrb lhm mthl alhywh aldnya kma anzlnh mn alsma fakhtlt bh nbat alard fasbh hshyma tdhrwh alryh wkan allh aly kl shy mqtdra

ayahs.translation_en: And present to them the example of the life of this world, [its being] like rain which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it and [then] it becomes dry remnants, scattered by the winds. And Allah is ever, over all things, Perfect in Ability.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: واضرب لهم مثل الحيوه الدنيا كما انزلنه من السما فاختلط به نبات الارض فاصبح هشيما تذروه الريح وكان الله علي كل شي مقتدرا

ayahs.text_ar: ٱلْمَالُ وَٱلْبَنُونَ زِينَةُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَٱلْبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًۭا وَخَيْرٌ أَمَلًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: المال والبنون زينه الحيوه الدنيا والبقيت الصلحت خير عند ربك ثوابا وخير املا
ayahs.transliteration: almal walbnwn zynh alhywh aldnya walbqyt alslht khyr and rbk thwaba wkhyr amla
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: almal walbnwn zynh alhywh aldnya walbqyt alslht hyr and rbk twaba whyr amla
ayahs.translation_en: Wealth and children are [but] adornment of the worldly life. But the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for [one's] hope.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: المال والبنون زينه الحيوه الدنيا والبقيت الصلحت خير عند ربك ثوابا وخير املا

ayahs.text_ar: وَيَوْمَ نُسَيِّرُ ٱلْجِبَالَ وَتَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ بَارِزَةًۭ وَحَشَرْنَٰهُمْ فَلَمْ نُغَادِرْ مِنْهُمْ أَحَدًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: ويوم نسير الجبال وتري الارض بارزه وحشرنهم فلم نغادر منهم احدا
ayahs.transliteration: wywm nsyr aljbal wtry alard barzh whshrnhm flm nghadr mnhm ahda
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wywm nsyr aljbal wtry alard barzh whsrnhm flm ngadr mnhm ahda
ayahs.translation_en: And [warn of] the Day when We will remove the mountains and you will see the earth prominent, and We will gather them and not leave behind from them anyone.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ويوم نسير الجبال وتري الارض بارزه وحشرنهم فلم نغادر منهم احدا

ayahs.text_ar: وَعُرِضُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ صَفًّۭا لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا كَمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۭ ۚ بَلْ زَعَمْتُمْ أَلَّن نَّجْعَلَ لَكُم مَّوْعِدًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وعرضوا علي ربك صفا لقد جيتمونا كما خلقنكم اول مره بل زعمتم الن نجعل لكم موعدا
ayahs.transliteration: wardwa aly rbk sfa lqd jatmwna kma khlqnkm awl mrh bl zamtm aln njal lkm mwada
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wardwa aly rbk sfa lqd jatmwna kma hlqnkm awl mrh bl zamtm aln njal lkm mwada
ayahs.translation_en: And they will be presented before your Lord in rows, [and He will say], "You have certainly come to Us just as We created you the first time. But you claimed that We would never make for you an appointment."
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وعرضوا علي ربك صفا لقد جيتمونا كما خلقنكم اول مره بل زعمتم الن نجعل لكم موعدا

ayahs.text_ar: وَوُضِعَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ فَتَرَى ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا فِيهِ وَيَقُولُونَ يَٰوَيْلَتَنَا مَالِ هَٰذَا ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيرَةًۭ وَلَا كَبِيرَةً إِلَّآ أَحْصَىٰهَا ۚ وَوَجَدُوا۟ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ حَاضِرًۭا ۗ وَلَا يَظْلِمُ رَبُّكَ أَحَدًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: ووضع الكتب فتري المجرمين مشفقين مما فيه ويقولون يويلتنا مال هذا الكتب لا يغادر صغيره ولا كبيره الا احصيها ووجدوا ما عملوا حاضرا ولا يظلم ربك احدا
ayahs.transliteration: wwda alktb ftry almjrmyn mshfqyn mma fyh wyqwlwn ywyltna mal hdha alktb la yghadr sghyrh wla kbyrh ala ahsyha wwjdwa ma amlwa hadra wla yzlm rbk ahda

ayahs.translation_en: And the record [of deeds] will be placed [open], and you will see the criminals fearful of that within it, and they will say, "Oh, woe to us! What is this book that leaves nothing small or great except that it has enumerated it?" And they will find what they did present [before them]. And your Lord does injustice to no one.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ووضع الكتب فتري المجرمين مشفقين مما فيه ويقولون يويلتنا مال هذا الكتب لا يغادر صغيره ولا كبيره الا احصيها ووجدوا ما عملوا حاضرا ولا يظلم ربك احدا

ayahs.text_ar: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۗ أَفَتَتَّخِذُونَهُۥ وَذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِى وَهُمْ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۢ ۚ بِئْسَ لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَدَلًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: واذ قلنا للمليكه اسجدوا لادم فسجدوا الا ابليس كان من الجن ففسق عن امر ربه افتتخذونه وذريته اوليا من دوني وهم لكم عدو بيس للظلمين بدلا
ayahs.transliteration: wadh qlna llmlakh asjdwa ladm fsjdwa ala ablys kan mn aljn ffsq an amr rbh afttkhdhwnh wdhryth awlya mn dwny whm lkm adw bas llzlmyn bdla

ayahs.translation_en: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He was of the jinn and departed from the command of his Lord. Then will you take him and his descendants as allies other than Me while they are enemies to you? Wretched it is for the wrongdoers as an exchange.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: واذ قلنا للمليكه اسجدوا لادم فسجدوا الا ابليس كان من الجن ففسق عن امر ربه افتتخذونه وذريته اوليا من دوني وهم لكم عدو بيس للظلمين بدلا

ayahs.text_ar: ۞ مَّآ أَشْهَدتُّهُمْ خَلْقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا خَلْقَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمَا كُنتُ مُتَّخِذَ ٱلْمُضِلِّينَ عَضُدًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: ما اشهدتهم خلق السموت والارض ولا خلق انفسهم وما كنت متخذ المضلين عضدا

ayahs.translation_en: I did not make them witness to the creation of the heavens and the earth or to the creation of themselves, and I would not have taken the misguiders as assistants.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ما اشهدتهم خلق السموت والارض ولا خلق انفسهم وما كنت متخذ المضلين عضدا

ayahs.text_ar: وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ نَادُوا۟ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّوْبِقًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: ويوم يقول نادوا شركاي الذين زعمتم فدعوهم فلم يستجيبوا لهم وجعلنا بينهم موبقا

ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wywm yqwl nadwa srkay aldyn zamtm fdawhm flm ystjybwa lhm wjalna bynhm mwbqa
ayahs.translation_en: And [warn of] the Day when He will say, "Call 'My partners' whom you claimed," and they will invoke them, but they will not respond to them. And We will put between them [a valley of] destruction.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ويوم يقول نادوا شركاي الذين زعمتم فدعوهم فلم يستجيبوا لهم وجعلنا بينهم موبقا

ayahs.text_ar: وَرَءَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ ٱلنَّارَ فَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُم مُّوَاقِعُوهَا وَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ عَنْهَا مَصْرِفًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: ورا المجرمون النار فظنوا انهم مواقعوها ولم يجدوا عنها مصرفا

ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wra almjrmwn alnar fznwa anhm mwaqawha wlm yjdwa anha msrfa
ayahs.translation_en: And the criminals will see the Fire and will be certain that they are to fall therein. And they will not find from it a way elsewhere.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ورا المجرمون النار فظنوا انهم مواقعوها ولم يجدوا عنها مصرفا

ayahs.text_ar: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ لِلنَّاسِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍۢ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَكْثَرَ شَىْءٍۢ جَدَلًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: ولقد صرفنا في هذا القران للناس من كل مثل وكان الانسن اكثر شي جدلا
ayahs.transliteration: wlqd srfna fy hdha alqran llnas mn kl mthl wkan alansn akthr shy jdla

ayahs.translation_en: And We have certainly diversified in this Qur'an for the people from every [kind of] example; but man has ever been, most of anything, [prone to] dispute.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ولقد صرفنا في هذا القران للناس من كل مثل وكان الانسن اكثر شي جدلا

ayahs.text_ar: وَمَا مَنَعَ ٱلنَّاسَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ قُبُلًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وما منع الناس ان يومنوا اذ جاهم الهدي ويستغفروا ربهم الا ان تاتيهم سنه الاولين او ياتيهم العذاب قبلا
ayahs.transliteration: wma mna alnas an yumnwa adh jahm alhdy wystghfrwa rbhm ala an tatyhm snh alawlyn aw yatyhm aladhab qbla

ayahs.translation_en: And nothing has prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them and from asking forgiveness of their Lord except that there [must] befall them the [accustomed] precedent of the former peoples or that the punishment should come [directly] before them.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وما منع الناس ان يومنوا اذ جاهم الهدي ويستغفروا ربهم الا ان تاتيهم سنه الاولين او ياتيهم العذاب قبلا

ayahs.text_ar: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ ۚ وَيُجَٰدِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا۟ بِهِ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِى وَمَآ أُنذِرُوا۟ هُزُوًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وما نرسل المرسلين الا مبشرين ومنذرين ويجدل الذين كفروا بالبطل ليدحضوا به الحق واتخذوا ايتي وما انذروا هزوا

ayahs.translation_en: And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. And those who disbelieve dispute by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth and have taken My verses, and that of which they are warned, in ridicule.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وما نرسل المرسلين الا مبشرين ومنذرين ويجدل الذين كفروا بالبطل ليدحضوا به الحق واتخذوا ايتي وما انذروا هزوا

ayahs.text_ar: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا وَنَسِىَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ ۚ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًۭا ۖ وَإِن تَدْعُهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ فَلَن يَهْتَدُوٓا۟ إِذًا أَبَدًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: ومن اظلم ممن ذكر بايت ربه فاعرض عنها ونسي ما قدمت يداه انا جعلنا علي قلوبهم اكنه ان يفقهوه وفي اذانهم وقرا وان تدعهم الي الهدي فلن يهتدوا اذا ابدا

ayahs.translation_en: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord but turns away from them and forgets what his hands have put forth? Indeed, We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if you invite them to guidance - they will never be guided, then - ever.

ayahs.text_ar: وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ذُو ٱلرَّحْمَةِ ۖ لَوْ يُؤَاخِذُهُم بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ۚ بَل لَّهُم مَّوْعِدٌۭ لَّن يَجِدُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَوْئِلًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وربك الغفور ذو الرحمه لو يواخذهم بما كسبوا لعجل لهم العذاب بل لهم موعد لن يجدوا من دونه مويلا

ayahs.translation_en: And your Lord is the Forgiving, full of mercy. If He were to impose blame upon them for what they earned, He would have hastened for them the punishment. Rather, for them is an appointment from which they will never find an escape.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وربك الغفور ذو الرحمه لو يواخذهم بما كسبوا لعجل لهم العذاب بل لهم موعد لن يجدوا من دونه مويلا

ayahs.text_ar: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوا۟ وَجَعَلْنَا لِمَهْلِكِهِم مَّوْعِدًۭا

ayahs.translation_en: And those cities - We destroyed them when they wronged, and We made for their destruction an appointed time.

ayahs.translation_en: And [mention] when Moses said to his servant, "I will not cease [traveling] until I reach the junction of the two seas or continue for a long period."

ayahs.translation_en: So when they had passed beyond it, [Moses] said to his boy, "Bring us our morning meal. We have certainly suffered in this, our journey, [much] fatigue."

ayahs.text_ar_normalized: فانطلقا حتي اذا اتيا اهل قريه استطعما اهلها فابوا ان يضيفوهما فوجدا فيها جدارا يريد ان ينقض فاقامه قال لو شيت لتخذت عليه اجرا

ayahs.transliteration_normalized: fantlqa hty ada atya ahl qryh asttama ahlha fabwa an ydyfwhma fwjda fyha jdara yryd an ynqd faqamh qal lw sat ltdt alyh ajra
ayahs.translation_en: So they set out, until when they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. And they found therein a wall about to collapse, so al-Khidh r restored it. [Moses] said, "If you wished, you could have taken for it a payment."
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: فانطلقا حتي اذا اتيا اهل قريه استطعما اهلها فابوا ان يضيفوهما فوجدا فيها جدارا يريد ان ينقض فاقامه قال لو شيت لتخذت عليه اجرا

ayahs.text_ar: قَالَ هَٰذَا فِرَاقُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنِكَ ۚ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأْوِيلِ مَا لَمْ تَسْتَطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًا

ayahs.translation_en: [Al-Khidh r] said, "This is parting between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: قال هذا فراق بيني وبينك سانبيك بتاويل ما لم تستطع عليه صبرا

ayahs.text_ar: أَمَّا ٱلسَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتْ لِمَسَٰكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ فَأَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَآءَهُم مَّلِكٌۭ يَأْخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصْبًۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: اما السفينه فكانت لمسكين يعملون في البحر فاردت ان اعيبها وكان وراهم ملك ياخذ كل سفينه غصبا

ayahs.translation_en: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working at sea. So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every [good] ship by force.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: اما السفينه فكانت لمسكين يعملون في البحر فاردت ان اعيبها وكان وراهم ملك ياخذ كل سفينه غصبا

ayahs.text_ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْغُلَٰمُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ فَخَشِينَآ أَن يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَٰنًۭا وَكُفْرًۭا

ayahs.translation_en: And as for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief.

ayahs.text_ar: فَأَرَدْنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُ زَكَوٰةًۭ وَأَقْرَبَ رُحْمًۭا

ayahs.translation_en: So we intended that their Lord should substitute for them one better than him in purity and nearer to mercy.

ayahs.text_ar_normalized: واما الجدار فكان لغلمين يتيمين في المدينه وكان تحته كنز لهما وكان ابوهما صلحا فاراد ربك ان يبلغا اشدهما ويستخرجا كنزهما رحمه من ربك وما فعلته عن امري ذلك تاويل ما لم تسطع عليه صبرا

ayahs.translation_en: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous. So your Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. And I did it not of my own accord. That is the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience."

ayahs.translation_en: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about Dhul-Qarnayn. Say, "I will recite to you about him a report."

ayahs.text_ar: إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ سَبَبًۭا

ayahs.translation_en: Indeed We established him upon the earth, and We gave him to everything a way.

ayahs.translation_en: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun, he found it [as if] setting in a spring of dark mud, and he found near it a people. Allah said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, either you punish [them] or else adopt among them [a way of] goodness."

ayahs.translation_en: He said, "As for one who wrongs, we will punish him. Then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with a terrible punishment.

ayahs.translation_en: But as for one who believes and does righteousness, he will have a reward of Paradise, and we will speak to him from our command with ease."

ayahs.text_ar: قَالُوا۟ يَٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا

ayahs.translation_en: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: قال رب اجعل لي ايه قال ايتك الا تكلم الناس ثلث ليال سويا

ayahs.text_ar: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: فخرج علي قومه من المحراب فاوحي اليهم ان سبحوا بكره وعشيا

ayahs.transliteration_normalized: fhrj aly qwmh mn almhrab fawhy alyhm an sbhwa bkrh wasya
ayahs.translation_en: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allah] in the morning and afternoon.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: فخرج علي قومه من المحراب فاوحي اليهم ان سبحوا بكره وعشيا

ayahs.text_ar: يَٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍۢ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّۭا

ayahs.transliteration_normalized: yyhyy hd alktb bqwh watynh alhkm sbya
ayahs.translation_en: [Allah] said, "O John, take the Scripture with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ييحيي خذ الكتب بقوه واتينه الحكم صبيا

ayahs.text_ar: وَحَنَانًۭا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةًۭ ۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وحنانا من لدنا وزكوه وكان تقيا
ayahs.transliteration: whnana mn ldna wzkwh wkan tqya
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: whnana mn ldna wzkwh wkan tqya
ayahs.translation_en: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allah
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وحنانا من لدنا وزكوه وكان تقيا

ayahs.text_ar: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وبرا بولديه ولم يكن جبارا عصيا

ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wbra bwldyh wlm ykn jbara asya
ayahs.translation_en: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وبرا بولديه ولم يكن جبارا عصيا

ayahs.text_ar: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا

ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wslm alyh ywm wld wywm ymwt wywm ybat hya
ayahs.translation_en: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وسلم عليه يوم ولد ويوم يموت ويوم يبعث حيا

ayahs.text_ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا

ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wadkr fy alktb mrym ad antbdt mn ahlha mkana srqya
ayahs.translation_en: And mention, [O Muhammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: واذكر في الكتب مريم اذ انتبذت من اهلها مكانا شرقيا

ayahs.text_ar: فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًۭا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًۭا سَوِيًّۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: فاتخذت من دونهم حجابا فارسلنا اليها روحنا فتمثل لها بشرا سويا

ayahs.translation_en: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: فاتخذت من دونهم حجابا فارسلنا اليها روحنا فتمثل لها بشرا سويا

ayahs.text_ar: قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّۭا

ayahs.transliteration_normalized: qalt any awd balrhmn mnk an knt tqya
ayahs.translation_en: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allah."
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: قالت اني اعوذ بالرحمن منك ان كنت تقيا

ayahs.text_ar: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمًۭا زَكِيًّۭا

ayahs.transliteration_normalized: qal anma ana rswl rbk lahb lk glma zkya
ayahs.translation_en: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy."
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: قال انما انا رسول ربك لاهب لك غلما زكيا

ayahs.text_ar: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌۭ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌۭ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّۭا

ayahs.translation_en: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: قالت اني يكون لي غلم ولم يمسسني بشر ولم اك بغيا

ayahs.text_ar: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ ۖ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: قال كذلك قال ربك هو علي هين ولنجعله ايه للناس ورحمه منا وكان امرا مقضيا

ayahs.translation_en: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.' "
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: قال كذلك قال ربك هو علي هين ولنجعله ايه للناس ورحمه منا وكان امرا مقضيا

ayahs.text_ar: ۞ فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتْ بِهِۦ مَكَانًۭا قَصِيًّۭا

ayahs.transliteration_normalized: fhmlt fantbdt bh mkana qsya
ayahs.translation_en: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.

ayahs.text_ar: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًۭا مَّنسِيًّۭا

ayahs.translation_en: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."

ayahs.text_ar: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّۭا

ayahs.translation_en: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.

ayahs.text_ar: وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًۭا جَنِيًّۭا

ayahs.translation_en: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.

ayahs.text_ar_normalized: فكلي واشربي وقري عينا فاما ترين من البشر احدا فقولي اني نذرت للرحمن صوما فلن اكلم اليوم انسيا

ayahs.translation_en: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.' "

ayahs.translation_en: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.

ayahs.translation_en: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"

ayahs.translation_en: Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: اوليك الذين انعم الله عليهم من النبين من ذريه ادم وممن حملنا مع نوح ومن ذريه ابرهيم واسريل وممن هدينا واجتبينا اذا تتلي عليهم ايت الرحمن خروا سجدا وبكيا

ayahs.text_ar: ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: فخلف من بعدهم خلف اضاعوا الصلوه واتبعوا الشهوت فسوف يلقون غيا

ayahs.translation_en: But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -

ayahs.text_ar: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: الا من تاب وامن وعمل صلحا فاوليك يدخلون الجنه ولا يظلمون شيا

ayahs.translation_en: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: الا من تاب وامن وعمل صلحا فاوليك يدخلون الجنه ولا يظلمون شيا

ayahs.text_ar: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّۭا

ayahs.translation_en: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been coming.

ayahs.text_ar: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا الا سلما ولهم رزقهم فيها بكره وعشيا

ayahs.translation_en: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا الا سلما ولهم رزقهم فيها بكره وعشيا

ayahs.text_ar: تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّۭا

ayahs.translation_en: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: تلك الجنه التي نورث من عبادنا من كان تقيا

ayahs.text_ar: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّۭا

ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وما نتنزل الا بامر ربك له ما بين ايدينا وما خلفنا وما بين ذلك وما كان ربك نسيا

ayahs.text_ar_normalized: رب السموت والارض وما بينهما فاعبده واصطبر لعبدته هل تعلم له سميا

ayahs.translation_en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: رب السموت والارض وما بينهما فاعبده واصطبر لعبدته هل تعلم له سميا

ayahs.translation_en: And the disbeliever says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ويقول الانسن اذا ما مت لسوف اخرج حيا

ayahs.text_ar: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا

ayahs.transliteration_normalized: awla ydkr alansn ana hlqnh mn qbl wlm yk sya
ayahs.translation_en: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?

ayahs.text_ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّۭا

ayahs.translation_en: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ثم لنحن اعلم بالذين هم اولي بها صليا

ayahs.text_ar: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا

ayahs.text_ar: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّۭا

ayahs.translation_en: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"

ayahs.translation_en: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?

ayahs.translation_en: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]?"

ayahs.text_ar: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًۭا

ayahs.text_ar_normalized: افلم يهد لهم كم اهلكنا قبلهم من القرون يمشون في مسكنهم ان في ذلك لايت لاولي النهي

ayahs.translation_en: And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, punishment would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed].

ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: فاصبر علي ما يقولون وسبح بحمد ربك قبل طلوع الشمس وقبل غروبها ومن اناي اليل فسبح واطراف النهار لعلك ترضي

ayahs.translation_en: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring.

ayahs.translation_en: And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وامر اهلك بالصلوه واصطبر عليها لا نسلك رزقا نحن نرزقك والعقبه للتقوي

ayahs.translation_en: And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?

ayahs.text_ar: قُلْ كُلٌّۭ مُّتَرَبِّصٌۭ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ ٱلسَّوِىِّ وَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ

ayahs.translation_en: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him"- that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ومن يقل منهم اني اله من دونه فذلك نجزيه جهنم كذلك نجزي الظلمين

ayahs.text_ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًۭا فَفَتَقْنَٰهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ ۖ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

ayahs.translation_en: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.

ayahs.text_ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ

ayahs.text_ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ ۖ أَفَإِي۟ن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِدُونَ

ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wma jalna lbsr mn qblk alhld afayn mt fhm alhldwn
ayahs.translation_en: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?

ayahs.text_ar: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۗ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةًۭ ۖ وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ

ayahs.text_ar: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَذْكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: واذا راك الذين كفروا ان يتخذونك الا هزوا اهذا الذي يذكر الهتكم وهم بذكر الرحمن هم كفرون

ayahs.translation_en: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who insults your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.

ayahs.text_ar: خُلِقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِنْ عَجَلٍۢ ۚ سَأُو۟رِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِى فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ

ayahs.translation_en: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...

ayahs.text_ar: بَلْ تَأْتِيهِم بَغْتَةًۭ فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ

ayahs.translation_en: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.

ayahs.translation_en: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

ayahs.translation_en: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: قل من يكلوكم باليل والنهار من الرحمن بل هم عن ذكر ربهم معرضون

ayahs.text_ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلْوَحْىِ ۚ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ

ayahs.translation_en: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ولين مستهم نفحه من عذاب ربك ليقولن يويلنا انا كنا ظلمين

ayahs.text_ar: فَفَهَّمْنَٰهَا سُلَيْمَٰنَ ۚ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيْنَا حُكْمًۭا وَعِلْمًۭا ۚ وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ ٱلْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَٱلطَّيْرَ ۚ وَكُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ

ayahs.translation_en: O People, if you should be in doubt about the Resurrection, then [consider that] indeed, We created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot, and then from a lump of flesh, formed and unformed - that We may show you. And We settle in the wombs whom We will for a specified term, then We bring you out as a child, and then [We develop you] that you may reach your [time of] maturity. And among you is he who is taken in [early] death, and among you is he who is returned to the most decrepit [old] age so that he knows, after [once having] knowledge, nothing. And you see the earth barren, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind.

ayahs.text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلْنَٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَوَآءً ٱلْعَٰكِفُ فِيهِ وَٱلْبَادِ ۚ وَمَن يُرِدْ فِيهِ بِإِلْحَادٍۭ بِظُلْمٍۢ نُّذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: ان الذين كفروا ويصدون عن سبيل الله والمسجد الحرام الذي جعلنه للناس سوا العكف فيه والباد ومن يرد فيه بالحاد بظلم نذقه من عذاب اليم

ayahs.text_ar: وَأَذِّن فِى ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَجِّ يَأْتُوكَ رِجَالًۭا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرٍۢ يَأْتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقٍۢ

ayahs.text_ar: لِّيَشْهَدُوا۟ مَنَٰفِعَ لَهُمْ وَيَذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ فِىٓ أَيَّامٍۢ مَّعْلُومَٰتٍ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ ۖ فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا۟ ٱلْبَآئِسَ ٱلْفَقِيرَ

ayahs.translation_en: That [has been commanded], and whoever honors the sacred ordinances of Allah - it is best for him in the sight of his Lord. And permitted to you are the grazing livestock, except what is recited to you. So avoid the uncleanliness of idols and avoid false statement,
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ذلك ومن يعظم حرمت الله فهو خير له عند ربه واحلت لكم الانعم الا ما يتلي عليكم فاجتنبوا الرجس من الاوثن واجتنبوا قول الزور

ayahs.translation_en: And for all religion We have appointed a rite [of sacrifice] that they may mention the name of Allah over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. For your god is one God, so to Him submit. And, [O Muhammad], give good tidings to the humble [before their Lord]

ayahs.text_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَهُمْ وَٱلْمُقِيمِى ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: الذين اذا ذكر الله وجلت قلوبهم والصبرين علي ما اصابهم والمقيمي الصلوه ومما رزقنهم ينفقون

ayahs.translation_en: Who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts are fearful, and [to] the patient over what has afflicted them, and the establishers of prayer and those who spend from what We have provided them.

ayahs.text_ar: وَٱلْبُدْنَ جَعَلْنَٰهَا لَكُم مِّن شَعَٰٓئِرِ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ فِيهَا خَيْرٌۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا صَوَآفَّ ۖ فَإِذَا وَجَبَتْ جُنُوبُهَا فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا۟ ٱلْقَانِعَ وَٱلْمُعْتَرَّ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرْنَٰهَا لَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

ayahs.text_ar: لَن يَنَالَ ٱللَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَآؤُهَا وَلَٰكِن يَنَالُهُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ مِنكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرَهَا لَكُمْ لِتُكَبِّرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَىٰكُمْ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

ayahs.translation_en: Their meat will not reach Allah, nor will their blood, but what reaches Him is piety from you. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may glorify Allah for that [to] which He has guided you; and give good tidings to the doers of good.

ayahs.text_ar: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدَٰفِعُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٍۢ كَفُورٍ

ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ان الله يدفع عن الذين امنوا ان الله لا يحب كل خوان كفور

ayahs.text_ar: أُذِنَ لِلَّذِينَ يُقَٰتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا۟ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِيرٌ
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: اذن للذين يقتلون بانهم ظلموا وان الله علي نصرهم لقدير
ayahs.transliteration: adhn lldhyn yqtlwn banhm zlmwa wan allh aly nsrhm lqdyr
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: adn lldyn yqtlwn banhm zlmwa wan allh aly nsrhm lqdyr
ayahs.translation_en: Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allah is competent to give them victory.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: اذن للذين يقتلون بانهم ظلموا وان الله علي نصرهم لقدير

ayahs.text_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ أُخْرِجُوا۟ مِن دِيَٰرِهِم بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ إِلَّآ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَلَوْلَا دَفْعُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاسَ بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍۢ لَّهُدِّمَتْ صَوَٰمِعُ وَبِيَعٌۭ وَصَلَوَٰتٌۭ وَمَسَٰجِدُ يُذْكَرُ فِيهَا ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ كَثِيرًۭا ۗ وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: الذين اخرجوا من ديرهم بغير حق الا ان يقولوا ربنا الله ولولا دفع الله الناس بعضهم ببعض لهدمت صومع وبيع وصلوت ومسجد يذكر فيها اسم الله كثيرا ولينصرن الله من ينصره ان الله لقوي عزيز
ayahs.transliteration: aldhyn akhrjwa mn dyrhm bghyr hq ala an yqwlwa rbna allh wlwla dfa allh alnas badhm bbad lhdmt swma wbya wslwt wmsjd ydhkr fyha asm allh kthyra wlynsrn allh mn ynsrh an allh lqwy azyz
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: aldyn ahrjwa mn dyrhm bgyr hq ala an yqwlwa rbna allh wlwla dfa allh alnas badm bbad lhdmt swma wbya wslwt wmsjd ydkr fyha asm allh ktyra wlynsrn allh mn ynsrh an allh lqwy azyz
ayahs.translation_en: [They are] those who have been evicted from their homes without right - only because they say, "Our Lord is Allah." And were it not that Allah checks the people, some by means of others, there would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in which the name of Allah is much mentioned. And Allah will surely support those who support Him. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: الذين اخرجوا من ديرهم بغير حق الا ان يقولوا ربنا الله ولولا دفع الله الناس بعضهم ببعض لهدمت صومع وبيع وصلوت ومسجد يذكر فيها اسم الله كثيرا ولينصرن الله من ينصره ان الله لقوي عزيز

ayahs.text_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِن مَّكَّنَّٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَمَرُوا۟ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهَوْا۟ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْأُمُورِ
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: الذين ان مكنهم في الارض اقاموا الصلوه واتوا الزكوه وامروا بالمعروف ونهوا عن المنكر ولله عقبه الامور
ayahs.transliteration: aldhyn an mknhm fy alard aqamwa alslwh watwa alzkwh wamrwa balmarwf wnhwa an almnkr wllh aqbh alamwr
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: aldyn an mknhm fy alard aqamwa alslwh watwa alzkwh wamrwa balmarwf wnhwa an almnkr wllh aqbh alamwr
ayahs.translation_en: [And they are] those who, if We give them authority in the land, establish prayer and give zakah and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. And to Allah belongs the outcome of [all] matters.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: الذين ان مكنهم في الارض اقاموا الصلوه واتوا الزكوه وامروا بالمعروف ونهوا عن المنكر ولله عقبه الامور

ayahs.text_ar: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَثَمُودُ
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وان يكذبوك فقد كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح وعاد وثمود
ayahs.transliteration: wan ykdhbwk fqd kdhbt qblhm qwm nwh waad wthmwd
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wan ykdbwk fqd kdbt qblhm qwm nwh wad wtmwd
ayahs.translation_en: And if they deny you, [O Muhammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and 'Aad and Thamud deny [their prophets],
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وان يكذبوك فقد كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح وعاد وثمود

ayahs.text_ar: وَقَوْمُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍۢ
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وقوم ابرهيم وقوم لوط
ayahs.transliteration: wqwm abrhym wqwm lwt
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wqwm abrhym wqwm lwt
ayahs.translation_en: And the people of Abraham and the people of Lot
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وقوم ابرهيم وقوم لوط

ayahs.text_ar: وَأَصْحَٰبُ مَدْيَنَ ۖ وَكُذِّبَ مُوسَىٰ فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: واصحب مدين وكذب موسي فامليت للكفرين ثم اخذتهم فكيف كان نكير
ayahs.transliteration: washb mdyn wkdhb mwsy famlyt llkfryn thm akhdhthm fkyf kan nkyr
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wasb mdyn wkdb mwsy famlyt llkfryn tm ahdtm fkyf kan nkyr
ayahs.translation_en: And the inhabitants of Madyan. And Moses was denied, so I prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: واصحب مدين وكذب موسي فامليت للكفرين ثم اخذتهم فكيف كان نكير

ayahs.text_ar: فَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌۭ فَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئْرٍۢ مُّعَطَّلَةٍۢ وَقَصْرٍۢ مَّشِيدٍ
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: فكاين من قريه اهلكنها وهي ظالمه فهي خاويه علي عروشها وبير معطله وقصر مشيد
ayahs.transliteration: fkayn mn qryh ahlknha why zalmh fhy khawyh aly arwshha wbar matlh wqsr mshyd
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: fkayn mn qryh ahlknha why zalmh fhy hawyh aly arwsha wbar matlh wqsr msyd
ayahs.translation_en: And how many a city did We destroy while it was committing wrong - so it is [now] fallen into ruin - and [how many] an abandoned well and [how many] a lofty palace.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: فكاين من قريه اهلكنها وهي ظالمه فهي خاويه علي عروشها وبير معطله وقصر مشيد

ayahs.text_ar: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌۭ يَعْقِلُونَ بِهَآ أَوْ ءَاذَانٌۭ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا ۖ فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعْمَى ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ وَلَٰكِن تَعْمَى ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلَّتِى فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: افلم يسيروا في الارض فتكون لهم قلوب يعقلون بها او اذان يسمعون بها فانها لا تعمي الابصر ولكن تعمي القلوب التي في الصدور
ayahs.transliteration: aflm ysyrwa fy alard ftkwn lhm qlwb yaqlwn bha aw adhan ysmawn bha fanha la tamy alabsr wlkn tamy alqlwb alty fy alsdwr
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: aflm ysyrwa fy alard ftkwn lhm qlwb yaqlwn bha aw adan ysmawn bha fanha la tamy alabsr wlkn tamy alqlwb alty fy alsdwr
ayahs.translation_en: So have they not traveled through the earth and have hearts by which to reason and ears by which to hear? For indeed, it is not eyes that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts which are within the breasts.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: افلم يسيروا في الارض فتكون لهم قلوب يعقلون بها او اذان يسمعون بها فانها لا تعمي الابصر ولكن تعمي القلوب التي في الصدور

ayahs.text_ar: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ وَلَن يُخْلِفَ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥ ۚ وَإِنَّ يَوْمًا عِندَ رَبِّكَ كَأَلْفِ سَنَةٍۢ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: ويستعجلونك بالعذاب ولن يخلف الله وعده وان يوما عند ربك كالف سنه مما تعدون
ayahs.transliteration: wystajlwnk baladhab wln ykhlf allh wadh wan ywma and rbk kalf snh mma tadwn
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wystajlwnk baladab wln yhlf allh wad wan ywma and rbk kalf snh mma tadwn
ayahs.translation_en: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. But Allah will never fail in His promise. And indeed, a day with your Lord is like a thousand years of those which you count.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: ويستعجلونك بالعذاب ولن يخلف الله وعده وان يوما عند ربك كالف سنه مما تعدون

ayahs.text_ar: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَمْلَيْتُ لَهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌۭ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهَا وَإِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وكاين من قريه امليت لها وهي ظالمه ثم اخذتها والي المصير
ayahs.transliteration: wkayn mn qryh amlyt lha why zalmh thm akhdhtha waly almsyr
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wkayn mn qryh amlyt lha why zalmh tm ahdta waly almsyr
ayahs.translation_en: And for how many a city did I prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. Then I seized it, and to Me is the [final] destination.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وكاين من قريه امليت لها وهي ظالمه ثم اخذتها والي المصير

ayahs.text_ar: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: قل يايها الناس انما انا لكم نذير مبين
ayahs.transliteration: ql yayha alnas anma ana lkm ndhyr mbyn
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: ql yayha alnas anma ana lkm ndyr mbyn
ayahs.translation_en: Say, "O people, I am only to you a clear warner."
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: قل يايها الناس انما انا لكم نذير مبين

ayahs.text_ar: فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَرِزْقٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: فالذين امنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهم مغفره ورزق كريم
ayahs.transliteration: faldhyn amnwa wamlwa alslht lhm mghfrh wrzq krym
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: faldyn amnwa wamlwa alslht lhm mgfrh wrzq krym
ayahs.translation_en: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: فالذين امنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهم مغفره ورزق كريم

ayahs.text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوْا۟ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: والذين سعوا في ايتنا معجزين اوليك اصحب الجحيم
ayahs.transliteration: waldhyn sawa fy aytna majzyn awlak ashb aljhym
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: waldyn sawa fy aytna majzyn awlak asb aljhym
ayahs.translation_en: But the ones who strove against Our verses, [seeking] to cause failure - those are the companions of Hellfire.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: والذين سعوا في ايتنا معجزين اوليك اصحب الجحيم

ayahs.text_ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍۢ وَلَا نَبِىٍّ إِلَّآ إِذَا تَمَنَّىٰٓ أَلْقَى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ فِىٓ أُمْنِيَّتِهِۦ فَيَنسَخُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ ٱللَّهُ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: وما ارسلنا من قبلك من رسول ولا نبي الا اذا تمني القي الشيطن في امنيته فينسخ الله ما يلقي الشيطن ثم يحكم الله ايته والله عليم حكيم
ayahs.transliteration: wma arslna mn qblk mn rswl wla nby ala adha tmny alqy alshytn fy amnyth fynskh allh ma ylqy alshytn thm yhkm allh ayth wallh alym hkym
ayahs.transliteration_normalized: wma arslna mn qblk mn rswl wla nby ala ada tmny alqy alsytn fy amnyt fyns allh ma ylqy alsytn tm yhkm allh ayt wallh alym hkym
ayahs.translation_en: And We did not send before you any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke [or recited], Satan threw into it [some misunderstanding]. But Allah abolishes that which Satan throws in; then Allah makes precise His verses. And Allah is Knowing and Wise.
ayahs.text_ar_search_normalized: وما ارسلنا من قبلك من رسول ولا نبي الا اذا تمني القي الشيطن في امنيته فينسخ الله ما يلقي الشيطن ثم يحكم الله ايته والله عليم حكيم

ayahs.text_ar: لِّيَجْعَلَ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَٱلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَفِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
ayahs.text_ar_normalized: ليجعل ما يلقي الشيطن فتنه للذين في قلوبهم مرض والقاسيه قلوبهم وان الظلمين لفي شقاق بعيد
